pad_width.description: specify the pad width for each dimension of an array. Padding widths may be separately specified for *before* and *after* the array. Options are:

mode.description: a string or callable. Supported pad modes are:

constant_values.description: referenced for ``mode = 'constant'``. Specify the constant value to pad with.

stat_length.description: referenced for ``mode in ['maximum', 'mean', 'median', 'minimum']``. An integer or tuple specifying the number of edge values to use when calculating the statistic.

end_values.description: referenced for ``mode = 'linear_ramp'``. Specify the end values to ramp the padding values to.

reflect_type.description: referenced for ``mode in ['reflect', 'symmetric']``. Specify whether to use even or odd reflection.
